findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, discarding recorded logs
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext (and New) returns a brand-new TestLogger instead of the receiver. Since LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), any test using log.TestLogger to assert on InfoLogs/ErrorLogs counts and messages will observe zero calls, because the log is recorded on a throwaway instance. This silently makes existing/future logger-middleware assertions vacuous. Return the same instance (or one sharing the same Logs state).

findings.title: Contextual logger not applied to stream endpoints
findings.body: SubscribeStream, PublishStream and RunStream pass the context through unchanged, so logs emitted downstream for streaming requests get no pluginId/dsUID/endpoint attributes. Since this middleware's sole purpose is enriching the context, adding instrumentContext for these three endpoints would make logging consistent across all client methods.

findings.title: traceID may be dropped from plugin request logs
findings.body: The explicit `traceID` log param (previously added via tracing.TraceIDFromContext) was removed and replaced by m.logger.FromContext(ctx). This only preserves the traceID field if the infra logger's FromContext injects it and the span is recording; otherwise plugin egress logs lose correlation with traces, breaking existing log queries/dashboards that filter on traceID.
